text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import invoice
import unittest
import io
source = Path('amounts.py').read_text()
early = '    if isinstance(value, int):\n        return value\n'
quantized = '    return int((Decimal(value) * 100).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))'
assert source.count(early) == source.count(quantized) == 1
variants = {
    'current': source,
    'A-only': source.replace(early, ''),
    'B-only': source.replace(quantized, '    return int(Decimal(value) * 100)'),
}
cases = [('1.005', 101), ('-1.005', -101), ('2.34', 234)]
for label, code in variants.items():
    namespace = {}
    exec(compile(code, f'<{label}>', 'exec'), namespace)
    with patch.object(invoice, 'amount_cents', namespace['amount_cents']):
        print(label)
        for value, required in cases:
            actual = invoice.invoice_total(value)
            print(f'  invoice_total({value!r}): actual={actual}, required={required}, {"PASS" if actual == required else "FAIL"}')
        stream = io.StringIO()
        suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('.', pattern='test_invoice.py')
        result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream).run(suite)
        print(stream.getvalue())
        assert len(result.failures) == (2 if label == 'B-only' else 0)
        assert not result.errors
PY
 git status --short","max_output_tokens":4000}));
